candidates.change_summary: Change the return statement from `return true;` to `return false;` so successful calls return false instead of true.
Change the empty-array check from length > 0 to length > 1, so calls with exactly one recipient revert.
Loop only over the first _tos.length - 1 recipients, skipping the last transfer.
Transfer v+1 instead of v in each transferFrom call.
Remove the revert on call failure so transfer returns true even when a transferFrom call fails.
Return false instead of true on success.
Change the final return statement from `return true;` to `return false;`.
